name: Welsheranto D. Anoyance
original_name: エルシェラント・ディ・アノイアンス
source:
One of Id's former blood servants and a Second (vampire turned from human by a First/Shinso) who has been alive for the better part of four hundred years.  She was originally an Irish (indications are she was from Dublin) pub waitress.  She is sent to mentor and assess Jun for his potential as a successor to his grandfather shortly after the story begins.  She holds a number of roles in the story, as mentor, mother, sister, and lover, and she carries them out with aplomb.  She can be extremely cold and ruthless with those outside her family, and even with those inside the family, she is quietly strict while looking after them at all times.  She really does love Jun from the very start, and she never lies to him, though she doesn't tell him everything.  Her Moon Ties ability, Dead Copy, allows her to break down objects on the particulate level and reconstitute them into various shapes and substances she has 'recorded'.  This can be applied to anything from making food out of random materials to replacing lost limbs and organs.  However, the appearance is always changed, if slightly.
[spoiler] Her first love and lover was Id, who treated her as a replacement for his own mother, giving her an insane amount of experience playing the role.  His act of abandoning her when he tried to elope with Yukari broke her heart and her loyalty to him completely beyond repair, though she still cares for him.[/spoiler]
